To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the in-plane PL measurements performed on VCSEL structures are useful to characterize the strain and the presence of defects in the active region.
we have performed in-plane micro-photluminescence and micro-reflectance measurements on a full VCSEL structure and on a VCSEL without P-DBR, both structures laterally oxidized.
we have performed optical characterization measurements of VCSELs with Al oxide confinement layers.
In summary, our research is concerned with
optical characterization of VCSELs for emission at 850 nm.
the optical characterization of VCSEL structures emitting at 850  nm.
optical characterization of VCSEL structures.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the optical characterization of the InGaAs/InP MQWs grown on InP substrate is a very useful tool for VCSEL design, fabrication, and characterization.
the PL and reflectivity measurements are a useful tool to investigate the VCSEL structures and to characterize the lateral oxidation process.
μ-PL and μ-reflectivity are useful techniques for the optical characterization of VCSELs.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the optical characterizations of the VCSELs have allowed us to obtain information about the quality and homogeneity of the structure and the effect of the lateral oxidation process on the optical properties.
we have shown that the PL spectrum of the VCSEL structures can be modified significantly by the presence or not the P-DBRs and oxide layers.
the PL spectrum of a VCSEL structure is the cumulative effect of the MQWs luminescence and the interferences of the P-DRB.
The main takeaway from our work is that
in-plane μ-PL measurements are very useful to characterize the quality of VCSELs.
the μ-PL and μ-reflectivity measurements can be used for a detailed characterization of the structure, in particular the presence or absence of the upper P-DBR.
the PL spectrum and polarization measurements can be used to evaluate the quality of the oxidation process.
